data.name: Noreen
data.gender_notes: Noreen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Nur' meaning 'light'. The name Noreen is often used to describe a radiant and shining woman. In Arabic, the name is transliterated as 'Nurain' or 'Noorain'. The name Noreen carries the meaning “Light, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Noreen usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who will bring light and guidance to her family and community
data.etymology: Noreen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noreen total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
